faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about vibe kanban, agentic coding, and Sciorex.

items.question: What is vibe kanban and how does Sciorex implement it?
items.answer: Vibe kanban is a workflow methodology where AI coding agents execute tasks in parallel while humans focus on planning, reviewing, and strategic oversight. Sciorex is the original vibe kanban platform - agents work in separate git worktrees so they never conflict, and you review changes through a built-in diff tool before merging.

items.question: Is Sciorex really free?
items.answer: Yes, Sciorex is completely free for personal and professional use. There are no subscriptions, no premium tiers, and no hidden costs. We're a wrapper for existing AI CLIs like Claude Code and Gemini CLI, so you only pay for what you already use (your own API keys or local models).

items.question: Does Sciorex support the ralph loop technique?
items.answer: Yes! Sciorex is fully compatible with the ralph loop (Ralph Wiggum loop) methodology. You can set up iterative workflows where agents continuously work on tasks, with progress persisting in git history rather than context windows. This makes Sciorex ideal for long-running agentic coding sessions.

items.question: How is Sciorex different from Cursor or Windsurf?
items.answer: Unlike Cursor or Windsurf, Sciorex is a vibe kanban platform that wraps existing AI CLIs rather than being a standalone IDE. This means you bring your own AI provider (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, etc.), keep full control over your data with 100% local execution, and can run parallel agents with git worktrees. Sciorex adds visual workflows, ticket tracking, and multi-agent orchestration on top of your existing agentic coding tools.

items.question: What AI providers and CLIs does Sciorex support?
items.answer: Sciorex supports all major agentic CLIs: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Codex CLI, and local models via LM Studio and Ollama. Since we wrap these existing tools, you get access to any AI provider they support, including Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, and open-source models.

items.question: Where is my data stored? Is Sciorex private?
items.answer: Sciorex is 100% local and private - your data never leaves your machine. All conversations, code, and files stay on your local system. We don't collect analytics, telemetry, or usage data. The CLIs you use (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, etc.) are the only components that may communicate with external APIs, depending on their configuration.

items.question: What can I build with vibe coding in Sciorex?
items.answer: Sciorex excels at agentic coding workflows: run parallel agents to implement features across multiple files, set up research pipelines that fetch and summarize papers, create documentation generators, build code review systems, and orchestrate any task requiring multiple AI agents working together with human oversight and vibe kanban tracking.
